cohort: The study included 45,149 deliveries recorded in hospital discharge records in the Abruzzo region of Italy between 2009 and 2013.
finding: The five-year primary caesarean section rate in Abruzzo, Italy, was 28.9%, showing a decreasing trend from 31.4% in 2009 to 26.1% in 2013, with diabetes, hypertension, twin pregnancy, fetal distress, and preterm delivery identified as significant risk factors.
mod_finding: The five-year primary caesarean section rate was 28.9%, showing a decreasing trend, with specific maternal risk factors like diabetes, hypertension, twin pregnancy, fetal distress, and preterm delivery significantly associated with this mode of birth.
